senses.gloss: dipping. Mekh. Bo, Pisḥa, s. 11 (ref. to Ex. XII, 22) על בל הגעה ט׳ you must dip the hyssop into the blood for each time you strike. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, ch. III, Par. 3.—
units: <cite ref="Yoma 88a:1">Yoma 88ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ט׳ בזמנה מצוה</he> the immersion in due time is obligatory (must not be postponed).
<cite ref="Menachot 7b:11">Men. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>שיעור ט׳</he> enough for all dippings.—Yoma l. c.; a. fr. <he>חייבי ט׳</he> those bound to take an immersion.
<cite ref="Niddah 29b:22">Nidd. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>ומטבילין אותה … ט׳</he> and we make her take immersions at intervals during ninety five days; a. fr.
